name: ProfessionalCertification

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends supporting each other's career goals
setting.background: One person wants to pay for training and certification while maintaining normal expenses

scenario_template.topic: Discussing the cost and potential value of a certification
scenario_template.note: They consider course fees, exam costs, materials, and travel

scenario_template.topic: Finding the upfront cost difficult to fit into the current budget
scenario_template.note: They do not want career development to create financial instability

scenario_template.topic: Creating a short-term education savings goal
scenario_template.note: They ask how to spread the cost across several months

scenario_template.topic: Separating course fees from related expenses
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them account for the complete cost

scenario_template.topic: Deciding which current expenses could temporarily be reduced
scenario_template.note: They compare short-term lifestyle changes with the career goal

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting the savings timeline if the certification date changes
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them revise the target without abandoning it

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a monthly certification savings amount
scenario_template.note: The goal feels achievable alongside their regular budget

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
